name: SIX homeobox 1

function.text: SIX1 encodes homeobox protein SIX1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to branchio-oto-renal syndrome (autosomal dominant); autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 23 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Wilms tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
